sources.snippet: LoomNet is a multi-view diffusion model that generates spatially consistent images from a single input image. It builds a shared latent space by splatting and fusing view-specific features onto orthogonal planes.

sources.title: LoomNet: Enhancing Multi-View Image Generation via Latent Space Weaving
sources.snippet: Abstract Generating consistent multi-view images from a single image remains challenging. Lack of spatial consistency often degrades 3D mesh quality in surface reconstruction.
